gloss: to hug each other; to embrace

definitions.gloss: to hug each other; to embrace
definitions.explanation: Of two or more people: to put their arms around each other, in joy, relief, or affection. The partner takes と: {友達|ともだち}と{抱|だ}き{合|あ}う.

examples.japanese: ふたり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抱|だ}き{合|あ}った。
examples.english: The two of them hugged each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抱|だ}き{合|あ}って⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The players hugged each other in joy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{十年|じゅうねん}ぶり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{姉妹|しまい}→姉妹：03201_shimai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泣|な}き→泣く：00655_naku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{抱|だ}き{合|あ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: At the airport, two sisters meeting for the first time in ten years were hugging each other in tears.

notes:
Intransitive and godan: {抱|だ}き{合|あ}う, {抱|だ}き{合|あ}った. 〜⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ makes the action mutual, so the subject is plural or the partner is marked with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抱|だ}き{合|あ}って⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧: to hug each other in joy
- {抱|だ}き{合|あ}って⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧: to weep in each other's arms
- ⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{抱|だ}き{合|あ}う: to hold each other tight

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抱|だ}きしめる→抱きしめる：06044_dakishimeru⟧: to hug tightly — one person holding another, not mutual
- ⟦{抱|だ}きつく→抱きつく：12805_dakitsuku⟧: to throw one's arms around someone — a sudden one-way hug
- ハグ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hug — casual loanword
